snippet.title: GAMEPLAY FOOTAGE - FORGOTTEN CEMETERY
snippet.description:
In Arena, each location is unique and has its own rules and setup, forcing you to adapt your strategy during all your journey.

➤ Wishlist here - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3307700/The_First_Spine__Arena/

The First Spine Arena is an exhilarating online competitive board-and-card game where two wizards clash in a tactical duel to reach the opponent's side. Every match unfolds on a dynamic grid, and you'll summon creatures, artifacts, and unleash spells to tip the battlefield in your favor. Thanks to level-based card generation and a robust matchmaking system, every duel feels fair, fresh, and fiercely competitive.

---
